title: Create a new vendor and validate it appears in the Vendors list
preconditions: User has AP clerk role and USMF legal entity is selectable.

steps.action: Log into D365 F&O and switch to the USMF legal entity.
Navigate to Modules > Accounts payable > Vendors > All vendors.
Click New to open the vendor creation form.
Fill Vendor account = 'TESTV-{timestamp}', Name = 'Test Vendor', Group = 'DOM'.
steps.expected: Fields accept input without validation errors.
Vendor is saved; header shows the new Vendor account code.

steps.action: Return to All vendors and search for the newly created account.
steps.expected: The new vendor is present in the results grid.
